before.build: omniroute-3.8.51-a58000c7-pr14904-pr13788 (a source build of a58000c7 with upstream PRs 14904 and 13788)
before.probe: checks/probe-before.json: the catalog has no cx/gpt-6.1-sol; a Responses call to cx/gpt-6.1-sol returns 400 'not available in the active live catalog for provider codex'; GPT-6 Astra at max answers 200

build.carried: upstream PR 13788 (two commits: /v1/alpha/search for Codex web.run) and upstream PR 15167 (one commit: GPT-6.1 Sol in the Codex registry and alias sets, so max reaches the wire); both open upstream on 2026-10-02

attempt_1.result: rolled back automatically after four failed probes
attempt_1.cause: every call answered 401: the gateway requires an API key, callers pass the documented loopback placeholder, and the new build's database migration left the placeholder unaccepted as a stored key; after the rollback the previous build, on the migrated database, answered 401 as well, and its port preflight also counted a browser's open dashboard connections as a listener ('Port 20128 is already in use by PID <browser>') and restarted several times before it bound
attempt_1.safety: OmniRoute wrote its own pre-migration database backup into its data directory (db_backups/, 03:34Z) before migrating; it was not needed

attempt_2.change: the launch agent passes the documented placeholder as the gateway's configured env key (OMNIROUTE_API_KEY=local-loopback, docs/secret-storage.md), independent of the database's key table; the rollback target carries the same change
attempt_2.result: switched; smoke start on a scratch port healthy; health 200; probe gate passed on its first attempt
attempt_2.probe: checks/probe-after.json: catalog 200 with cx/gpt-6.1-sol and cx/gpt-6-astra (618 models); cx/gpt-6.1-sol at body effort max 200; cx/gpt-6-astra at max 200; codex exec through the gateway with cx/gpt-6.1-sol exit 0

codex_follow.wrapper: scripts/omniroute-serve.sh.txt: the launch agent runs it; at every start it reads the installed Codex CLI's version and exports it as CODEX_CLIENT_VERSION (the plist value stays as the fallback), and records the announced version in the state directory
codex_follow.observed: the installed Codex moved to 0.160.0 during the switch; the gateway announced 0.160.0 at its start (03:44:47Z) without any edit

update_check.script: scripts/omniroute-update-check.py.txt: restarts the gateway when the installed Codex version differs from the announced one and no non-browser client holds a connection; posts a macOS notification and writes omniroute-update.json when an official OmniRoute release carries every carried PR; installs nothing
update_check.first_run: 2026-10-02T03:52Z: codex_follow unchanged (0.160.0 = 0.160.0); latest release v3.8.51; PRs 13788 and 15167 unmerged; no notice

limits: Upstream effort on the wire was not read back on this host (the gateway's call log is in its credential-bearing database, which was not opened); max for gpt-6.1-sol rests on PR 15167's source and its measured read-back on the workstation gateway (docs/decisions/2026-09-30-omniroute-rebuild.md, update of 06:32Z).

Web search through the gateway does not work on this build: with no credentialed search provider resolved, the /v1/alpha/search route falls back to DuckDuckGo lite, which timed out from this host (a direct request also timed out after 20 s); page opening was already unsupported ('Unsupported operation for /v1/alpha/search: open').
The build carries two open upstream PRs (a canary build in upstream's own terms); the update check flags when an official release carries both.
The omniroute row of manifests/stack.json (npm 3.8.50) is unchanged; it is a shared hot file and changes in its own lane:shared change.
